tagline: WZFO取景器相机，1956 年发布
description: WZFO于1956年推出的取景器相机。配备Bilar 1:8/65mm。快门速度1/50 sec. or B。使用roll film of type No. 120。

specs.英文简介: The Druh Synchro was a medium format camera made of bakelite by the Polish camera maker Warszawskie Zakłady Fotooptyczne (WZFO), it was advanced Druh with added PC sync port for flash and coldshoe.
